newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac to broadcast to France on Tuesday night.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to broadcast to France on Tuesday night.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will make a radio and television broadcast to the nation on Tuesday night, his office announced, after Prime Minister Alain Juppe said he would resign whatever the outcome of next Sunday's parliamentary election runoff.

Juppe announced his decision after the Socialist-led opposition strongly outpolled his centre-right coalition in Sunday's first round of voting, raising the prospect of an upset left-wing victory in the decisive second round.
